title: The Family Room
friction_meter: retired for Part 9; replaced by the before-and-after room signature
part9_signature_state: before-and-after room card of the media wall, toy shelf, and play floor from the doorway; before kept (Ch 6), after the ideal-state standard (Ch 25)
shine_layer: the everyday, hardest-working soft room; clean means clean and dry; lift the dry mess first; sweep the floor a child shares; heat with nowhere to go
clean_and_dry_rule: The family room is the hardest-working soft room in the house, and here clean means two things at once: genuinely clean, and genuinely dry...

reframes.dry_mess: Dried glue, glitter, and paint defeat a wet cloth...
reframes.floor_a_child_shares: In this room the last step of every zone is the most important...
reframes.heat_with_nowhere_to_go: Two quiet fire risks live in this room, and both are heat with nowhere to go...

the_six_zones: the primary media zone, the toy and play zone, the board game and puzzle zone, the blanket and comfort zone, the charging and device zone, and the craft and activity zone

primary_media.purpose: the TV, consoles, and controllers, ready to watch or play
inputs: microfiber set with a screen cloth (dry only)
key_steps: TV back panel and rear vents
lift each device and wipe the shelf
primary_media.inspect: cracked cable, fast-packing vent or hot console, shifting mount, drink ring, warm strip

toy_and_play.purpose: active-rotation toys a child can put away alone
inputs: vacuum with upholstery and crevice tools
key_steps: wash the toys, mesh bag for soft toys
toy_and_play.inspect: cracked sharp plastic, choke-sized loose part, musty bin base, rocking shelf, faded label

board_game_and_puzzle.inspect: crushed bottom-box corners, returning lid film, stray die on the floor, sagging shelf, damp back edge

blanket_and_comfort.purpose: the throws and cushions actually used, in an honest container
inputs: vacuum with upholstery tool and brush head
key_steps: wash every throw, dry, fold to one rectangle
check the radiator, heater grille, lamp shade, sofa back
blanket_and_comfort.inspect: scorched throw off a heater, warm lamp shade, musty throw, oily basket base, cracked woven rim

charging_and_device.purpose: one place to charge, on a surface that takes the heat
inputs: soft detail brush or compressed air for ports
key_steps: clear and wipe the table top
clear the charging ports of lint
wipe the devices, feel for heat
charging_and_device.inspect: cracked sheath near the plug, lint-packed port, warm strip, loose cable end, drink ring

craft_and_activity.purpose: supplies grouped so a project starts in one motion and the surface clears fast
key_steps: scrape the dry mess off the surface
craft_and_activity.inspect: scorch ring where the glue gun cools, cracked glue-gun cord, leaking glue staining a bin, tippy scissor cup, escaped beads on the floor

the_calls: the console with the save files
the game with one piece missing
the old phone with the photos on it
definition: A finished family room is one a child can play in on the floor and an adult can relax in at the end of a long day...
one_idea_to_keep: A family room is not clean because the surfaces are wiped. It is clean because you washed and dried the toys and throws properly, cleared the console vents, scraped the dried glue before you wiped, and finished on your hands and knees clearing the floor a child shares.
keywords: how to clean a family room
